These compounds are all potential modulators of Phosphodiesterase 6C, indicating a possible mechanism of action involving the regulation of this enzyme. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential role for Nornuciferidine in modulating Phosphodiesterase 6C through the activation of Protein delta homolog 1, which may serve as a bridge between the drug and the enzyme.
